workbench.listRequestLogs.description: Test calls only, kept 7 days. Each entry has the route, status, error code, duration, the pass, template or key the call touched, the PassBook-Version it pinned, and whether it sent Idempotency-Key, If-Match and PassBook-Version. No header value is kept. Filter with `passId`, `version`, `keyId`, `status` and `code`; poll with `after` to tail. A key needs the `logs:read` scope; a signed-in member names the organization with `orgId`.

workbench.getRequestLog.description: Bodies are redacted JSON, kept 24 hours, and only where the organization records them: always in a sandbox, elsewhere by the Record request bodies in Test setting. `bodiesRecorded` says which. Metadata is kept 7 days. The id is a log id or a request id.
